name: Chem de la Chem
summary: **Chem de la Chem** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] combining two cuts from the [[chemdawg|Chemdawg]] line, [[chemdawg-d|Chem D]] and [[i-95|I-95]]. A backcrossed selection, sold as Chem de la Chem BX1, has since been released by other growers.

sources.title: Chem De La Chem Strain (Chem D × I-95)
Chem De La Chem BX1 (Full Moon Genetics) :: Lineage & Hybrids
sources.note: Backcrossed BX1 release; corroborates the Chem D / I-95 cross behind the base cultivar.
